response.sql: WITH team_totals AS (SELECT team_id, SUM(games) AS total_games FROM home_game GROUP BY team_id), metrics AS (SELECT team_id, total_games, 1.0 * total_games / NULLIF(SUM(total_games) OVER (), 0) AS fraction_of_all_games, 1.0 * total_games / NULLIF((SELECT AVG(games) FROM home_game), 0) AS ratio_to_record_average FROM team_totals) SELECT team_id, total_games, fraction_of_all_games, ratio_to_record_average FROM metrics ORDER BY ratio_to_record_average IS NULL, ratio_to_record_average DESC LIMIT 10;
